plays.description: Takes a handoff and accelerates across the 25; commentary names Gardeck and Washington on the stop.
Stopped for one yard on third-and-11; the captions do not establish whether this was a run or reception.
Comes back for Lawrence's off-back-foot throw and gains 14 into Denver territory.
Lawrence completes a pass; sequence matches the DB's 22-yard short-left reception.
Catches Lawrence's downfield throw and extends to the Denver 1; Brandon Jones makes the tackle.
Scores on a direct snap around right end. Commentary credits a pulling block to a player captioned as Van Lennon.
plays.concept: direct snap; right end run; pulling blocker

plays.description: With Sutton in motion, Nix leaves the pocket and throws deep. Waddle wins a contested catch against Buster Brown at the Jacksonville 1.
plays.concept: deep middle shot; quarterback outside pocket

plays.description: Doubles back near the goal line but is contained by Hines-Allen without scoring.
Makes a short field goal. Captions call it 21 yards; the authoritative DB records 20.
Sacked as the pocket collapses; Malcolm Roach grabs his ankles. Commentary also mentions Zach Allen's pressure.
Makes an on-time reception from Nix; matches the 20-yard short-right completion.
Turns a reception into a big gain into Jacksonville territory.
Hauls in Nix's deep throw down the left side.
Pass intended for Courtland Sutton is intercepted by Jourdan Lewis in the back of the end zone for a touchback.
With Thomas in motion, Lawrence completes a nine-yard pass to the 30.
Makes a sliding attempt on a low throw; officials award a first down despite Denver disputing the catch.
Catches an outside throw for a first down across the 40 late in the half.
Catches a seven-yard pass with the clock running; a flag follows.
Makes a 44-yard field goal to give Jacksonville a 10-3 halftime lead.
Takes a toss outside for a first down.
Tries to work outside and is tripped up by Surtain; the captions do not establish the play type.
Takes a handoff, uses a stutter step, and is wrapped up crossing the 25.
Turns the corner for a first down.
Throws incomplete short of the goal line. Commentary names Allen and Singleton as waiting for the target.
Makes a 23-yard field goal to extend Jacksonville's lead to 13-3.
Apparently makes a first-down reception from Nix; the caption says 'tackle made by Waddle,' leaving the wording uncertain.
Takes a reverse from the 48 to the 32; exact official yardage is unavailable.
Avoids pressure and tosses the ball ahead on third-and-five; a flag is thrown and Gardeck is mentioned applying pressure. The result is unclear.
Makes a 45-yard field goal, cutting Jacksonville's lead to 13-6.
Cuts outside on the kickoff return following Lutz's field goal.
Third-and-six throw intended for Parker Washington is intercepted by R. Moss, who steps in front. DB records a three-yard return and Bonitto involvement.
plays.defender_beaten: R. Moss (interceptor); N. Bonitto (DB pressure credit)

plays.description: Keeps the ball on third-and-six and veers toward the sideline.
Catches a pass following a fake handoff. Commentary corrects the receiver's name to Adkins.
Catches a pass over the middle for a first down.
Makes an underneath catch on second-and-eight with Buster Brown in coverage.
Scores wide open on a short-right pass after a run fake and Nix movement. Commentary attributes Jacksonville's assignment confusion to Bryant's motion inside number 45.
plays.concept: play-action; quarterback movement; short right pass; pre-snap motion

plays.description: Lawrence targets Meyers downfield on third-and-eight. Captions say 'incomplete,' but the corresponding DB play records a 28-yard completion.
Lawrence double-clutches and throws outside toward Washington; the pass is broken up. The defender's captioned name is too garbled to identify reliably.
Fragmentary commentary refers to trying to put Jacksonville ahead. Sequence is consistent with the DB's missed 54-yard field goal, but the captions do not explicitly identify the kick or result.
Catches a pass into Jacksonville territory at the 45.
Makes a difficult catch on a long downfield throw from Nix.
Scores through right tackle. Commentary credits right-side down blocks, Franklin's blocking, and pulling guard Powers, number 71.
plays.concept: right tackle run; down blocks; pulling guard

plays.description: Rips through for eight yards before Riley Moss makes the tackle.
Deep third-and-11 throw toward Thomas falls incomplete with Patrick Surtain running stride for stride.
Motions before the snap and catches Nix's throw after Nix leaves the pocket. Flags follow; DB records declined defensive holding on M. Brown.
plays.concept: deep right pass; quarterback outside pocket; pre-snap motion
plays.defender_beaten: J. Lewis (DB tackler); M. Brown (declined holding)

plays.description: Runs up the middle for 12 yards and a first down near the two-minute warning. Commentary mentions left guard Powers.
Runs outside and deliberately goes down to help close out the game.

offense_strengths: Lawrence produced chunk completions to Thomas, Washington, and Meyers, with DB gains of 22, 32, and 28 yards.
Tuten scored on a direct snap and gained first downs on an outside toss and another corner-turning run.
Late-first-half completions helped set up Little's 44-yard field goal.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Waddle receptions of 49, 20, and 29 yards, plus additional underneath and middle catches.
Allowed consecutive 27-yard receptions to Badie and Franklin on a second-quarter possession.
Commentary explicitly identified motion-induced assignment confusion on Adkins's tying touchdown.
Denver's right-side down blocks and pulling guard opened Coleman's go-ahead touchdown run.

offense_strengths: Nix repeatedly found Waddle, including explosive completions after leaving the pocket.
Play-action produced an Adkins reception and his seven-yard touchdown; Bryant's motion helped create the touchdown opening.
Coleman scored behind down blocks and a pulling guard, then added a 12-yard middle run and a late outside run.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Jacksonville's 22-yard Thomas reception and 32-yard Washington reception before Tuten's touchdown.
Allowed multiple Tuten outside runs for first downs and a later eight-yard carry.
Allowed Jacksonville to move into field-goal range with several completions before halftime.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were viewed and no commands were run. The supplied DB is selective, so NO DB MATCH does not mean a play did not occur. Some caption-to-DB links rely on sequence, especially the 00:56 completion and fragmentary 08:19 field-goal reference. The Meyers captions conflict with the DB on completion status; the DB controls the recorded result. Unmatched names remain as captioned when identification is uncertain. Personnel and coverage are unknown unless explicitly stated; the slot-matchup and outside-blitz discussion cannot be assigned confidently to a specific play. Named tacklers, interceptors, and successful coverage defenders in defender_beaten are identified by role and do not imply they were beaten. Interception yards represent return yards; field-goal yards represent kick distance. Kickoffs, the Sutton pass-interference penalty, extra points, and other DB events without identifiable caption coverage were not added as separate highlights.
